name: projects-tab-state-readiness-failed
description: The page starts at the library, reads the empty registry, and the read of the tab state file fails with the text tab-state startup fixture failed, so the start of the project list ends with that error.
reason: The page start sends the theme of the window, which the Go producer does not run; it runs only log and workspace without a window (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
